definitions.full: H980. Bachurim בַּחֻרִים proper name, of a location ( young men's village ) of a small town of Benjamin beyond the Mt. of Olives on the way to Jericho (compare Rob BR i. 433 ; Kasteren ZPV 1890, 100 ff. ) 2Sam 3:16 ; 16:5 ; 17:18 ; 19:17 ; 1Kin 2:8 (= עַלְמוֺן according to ᵑ7 Jon Schwarz Marti-Schick ZPV iii. 8 f .
definitions.rootNote: or בַּחוּרִים ; masculine plural of 970 ; young men;
